value.rationale: The sharp radical/field-factor classification explains exactly when unitary ring graphs realize the random graph's full three-variable theory while none reaches its four-variable theory, includes all finite commutative rings, computes every two-anchor witness count, and settles vertex deletion resilience. It gives infinite finite examples within one FO^3 theory with unbounded chromatic number. Those features represent a natural structural and logical phase diagram rather than isolated computation.
